description.html: VasoMax Grand Pre is the ultimate pre workout pump supplement on the market formulated to enhance vasodilation, blood flow, cellular swelling and pumps from multiple fronts.* Priming the pump in VasoMax Grand Pre is a whopping 10 grams of pure L-Citrulline, one of the most effective and reliable vasodilators. L-Citrulline activates endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) increasing nitric oxide levels that relax blood vessels allowing them to expand. Up next is a pair of premium branded ingredients in Nitrosigine® and HesperiPump™. Nitrosigine® is a combination of arginine, silicate, and inositol which has been shown to promote nitric oxide (NO) production for improved blood flow, focus, and energy. It works in combination with citrulline to increase arginine levels. Arginine is the “fuel” for nitric oxide production. HesperiPump™ is a citrus aurantium extract standardized to a-glucosyl-hesperidin that supports increased NO production by metabolizing into heseperitin, a flavanoid that activates eNOS. To round out the comprehensive nitric oxide support system contained in VasoMax Grand Pre, we’ve included the antioxidant complex in Phyto-C® along with the ingredient AmentoPump™ that promotes NO production increasing cyclic guanosine monophosphate (cGMP). To address the 'water based pump' we included hefty doses of the osmolytes Betaine Anhydrous and Taurine along with Pink Himalayan Salt to fuel muscular fullness through enhanced cell volumization. Helping to increase the bioavailability of all of these pump enhancing ingredients we included Astrgin®, a trademarked combination extract of panax notoginseng and astralagus that has been shown to enhance the absorption of micronutrients by supporting nutrient transporters in the gut. VasoMax Grand Pre utilizes a myriad of synergistic mechanisms that improve nitric oxide production, blood flow, and cell volumization to deliver an unparalleled pump pre workout supplement offering stronger, harder, longer lasting pumps!

Carbohydrates have gotten a bad rap in recent times. But, this is more a result of the overconsumption of packaged and processed foods coupled with a severe lack of physical activity. The truth is that carbohydrates aren’t bad, they’re actually incredibly beneficial! Still, many individuals are concerned about “poor genetics” or “carb sensitivity.” That’s where a nutrient partitioning & glucose disposal agent comes in handy.*Enter SlinMax!SlinMax is a comprehensive glucose utilization and disposal agent that actually helps the body take advantage of the anabolic power of insulin for greater muscle growth and fat loss.*It all begins with Isolyn (Na-R-ALA), which is a bioavailable form of alpha lipoic acid that promotes insulin activity and blood flow, for greater nutrient delivery. Gymnema Sylvestre Extract is another agent that may help to reduce blood sugar after a meal via improving insulin signaling.Rounding out SlinMax is our combination of powerful research-backed ingredients in Berberine, Banaba leaf, Cinnamon, and Chromium. Berberine is a bioactive alkaloid that promotes better blood glucose levels via its actions on the gut microbiota. Banaba leaf contains Corosolic Acid and other compounds that are known to lower blood sugar levels by increasing insulin sensitivity, enhancing glucose uptake, and inhibiting alpha-glucosidase. Cinnamon is a common cooking spice held in high regard for its blood glucose-lowering effects. Last, but not least, Chromium is a trace mineral that serves as a critical factor for enhancing insulin activity.Taken together, SlinMax offers an unparalleled approach to blood glucose regulation and carbohydrate utilization promoting more stable energy levels, less fat storage, greater energy production, better performance, and maximum pumps!

Performax Labs presents HyperMax Shot, the ultimate ready-to-drink pre-workout shot engineered for athletes who demand serious performance without the hassle of powders, shakers, or bulky tubs. Designed for convenience and built with a fully loaded formula, HyperMax Shot delivers powerful energy, intense pumps, and enhanced workout performance — all packed into a compact 2oz bottle you can take anywhere. Whether you’re heading to the gym, traveling, training on the go, or simply forgot your pre-workout at home, HyperMax Shot ensures you never have to compromise your training intensity. Its ultra-portable size easily fits into your gym bag, backpack, pocket, or carry-on, making it the perfect solution for fast-paced lifestyles. HyperMax Shot features a fully built-out performance formula designed to help maximize your workouts from start to finish. Fueling the entire experience is 300mg of Caffeine Anhydrous, providing fast-hitting energy, focus, and mental drive to keep you locked in from your first set to your last. HyperMax Shot also includes high-potency Vitamin B6 and Vitamin B12 to support energy metabolism and overall performance. The ready-to-drink format means no mixing, no mess, and no need to consume large amounts of liquid before training. Simply twist open a bottle and experience the convenience of serious pre-workout performance anytime, anywhere. Whether you’re chasing bigger pumps, harder training sessions, increased focus, or simply need the convenience of grab-and-go performance, HyperMax Shot delivers everything you need in one compact powerhouse.

Introducing HyperBlaze. The thermogenic powerhouse pre-workout engineered to bring together intense energy, razor-sharp focus, massive pumps, endurance, and next-level fat-burning support in one completely loaded formula. HyperBlaze takes the performance foundation Performax Labs is known for and turns up the heat with a dedicated thermogenic matrix designed for athletes who want their pre-workout doing more than just getting them through another training session. This is where high-performance pre-workout meets serious cutting support. Fueling the performance side of HyperBlaze is a massive 8 gram dose of L-Citrulline, 3.2 grams of Beta Alanine, 200mg of Pine Bark Extract, and 200mg of Pink Himalayan Salt. Together, this performance-driven combination is designed to support nitric oxide production, blood flow, muscular pumps, hydration, endurance, and overall training output so you can keep pushing when the intensity starts climbing. For energy and focus, HyperBlaze comes loaded with 2 grams of L-Tyrosine, 500mg of ThinFen™, 330mg of Choline, 300mg of NeuroPEA™, Huperzine, and a massive 475mg total caffeine. The result is the hard-hitting energy, heightened drive, mental intensity, and locked-in focus you expect from a Performax Labs pre-workout—built for demanding training sessions where going through the motions isn't an option. But what truly separates HyperBlaze is the thermogenic side of the formula. We packed in 2 grams of L-Carnitine L-Tartrate and 1 gram of Acetyl-L-Carnitine, then combined them with 200mg of Cocoabuterol, 200mg of Juniper Berry Extract, 40mg of Paradoxine®, and 30mg of ProGBB® to create an aggressive thermogenic and metabolic support matrix built specifically for athletes looking to turn up the heat while they train. HyperBlaze doesn't sacrifice performance to become a fat-burning pre-workout—it was designed to deliver both. Taking the intensity another step further is 20mg of YoMax™, pushing HyperBlaze beyond the already aggressive level found in HyperMax'd Out, while 10mg of BioPerine® rounds out the formula to help support the absorption and utilization of its premium active ingredients. HyperBlaze isn't a fat burner with some pre-workout ingredients thrown in, and it isn't a pre-workout with a token thermogenic added to the label. It was built from the ground up to dominate both categories. Explosive energy. Locked-in focus. Full pumps. Serious performance. Relentless thermogenesis. When it's time to train harder, sweat harder, and bring the heat to your cut, light the fire with HyperBlaze.
